top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 achievement is mature and independently replicated, from proglucagon processing and the incretin effect through the active truncated peptide and receptor biology to outcome-proven therapies. P001 credits it as a discovery of the physiology and active forms of GLP-1 with Holst, Drucker and Mojsov, which is the cleanest fit to a discovery-based citation and the three-name cap. P002 (Knudsen in place of Mojsov) is a defensible second choice that credits the drug-design step, and either is far better than no award, so P000 is last.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no credited name is a documented collaborator (past nuclear-receptor work with Ronald Evans is not a candidate here)
